ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel coverage localized at the distal tips and right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains sparse, punctate high-intensity clusters. Right lobe displays a dense, linear-to-mottled high-intensity distribution originating from the distal tip and trailing edge, radiating inward towards the median notch. Contiguous white clusters are concentrated at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 125 degrees; shallow depth relative to total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys at distal tips (roughly 5-8 pixels in depth). Transitioning to moderate-frequency, rounded undulations along the mid-lobe boundaries toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with a shallow concave arc near the median notch transitioning to a pronounced convex arc at the mid-lobe, terminating in an upward-curved distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of textured, high-contrast beige/white pixel groups at both extreme distal tips, exhibiting three-dimensional relief against the flat fluke plane.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, cutting through the dark pigmentation streaks near the mid-trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lateral tips of both lobes; significant white pigment scarring/mottling localized on the right lobe's ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the left (primarily dark) and right (streaked/mottled) fluke lobes.
